scope: Proposition 7.2 of the manuscript “Numerical semiampleness of nef adjoint classes on compact Kähler manifolds” (preprints/Numerical-semiampleness-of-nef-adjoint-classes-on-compact-Kahler-manifolds-October-6-2026/numerical-generalized-abundance.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 036 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2f19b2f37c05dcf9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 47. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let T be a smooth compact Kähler manifold of dimension n, let (T, B) be a rational simple normal crossing klt pair with J = KT + B pseudo-effective, and let h : T → W be a surjective morphism to a smooth projective variety. There are a smooth compact Kähler modification T1 → T, an effective klt adjoint J1 on T1 as in (2.1), and a finite ordinary J1-negative program over W, ending at a normal compact Kähler klt pair (Y, ∆), such that for some positive integer b and an ample Cartier divisor AW on W, KY + ∆ + bh∗ Y AW is semiample. Here hY : Y → W is the descended morphism.
